events.text: During this watch session for synthetic patient P3 (characterised by adhesions from prior surgery), two safety alerts for clipping before achieving the Critical View of Safety (CVS) were triggered at t=391 and t=415. Both alerts were automatically acknowledged by the system due to the recording mode. Throughout the procedure (from t=411 to t=561), numerous verification contradictions occurred, indicating ongoing hook and scissors dissection of the cystic duct, artery, and plate despite these structures already being marked as skeletonised, clipped, or cut. The session concluded in the gallbladder-dissection phase with an incomplete CVS (2/3), no bleeding, and the common bile duct marked as at risk.
